# Boulevard Haussmann de Paris

> > The definitive guide to Boulevard Haussmann, Paris's premier luxury shopping district featuring Galeries Lafayette and Printemps department stores.

This comprehensive travel resource covers luxury shopping at Galeries Lafayette and Printemps, transportation via Metro stations (Havre-Caumartin, Auber, RER A), nearby attractions including Opera Garnier and the Louvre Museum, and practical visitor information for exploring Paris's iconic Boulevard Haussmann district.
